name: compute_volume
description: Compute the voxel volume (in mm³) of a label in a 3D mask volume.

parameters.name: mask_path
parameters.description: Filesystem path to a NIfTI (.nii or .nii.gz) integer-label mask.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: The voxel value identifying the target structure (1, 2, ...). Background is typically 0.

parameters.name: spacing_override
parameters.description: Optional [x, y, z] voxel spacing in mm. Defaults to the spacing in the NIfTI affine.

fields.name: voxel_count
fields.description: Number of voxels with the matching label.

fields.name: spacing_mm
fields.description: Spacing used in the calculation, [x, y, z] mm.
